description: A small stack of toy blocks sits on the green bedspread in front of a large dark pillow. The left hand and right hand move forward toward the stack, and both hands briefly hold the red top piece as a two-hand object before the right hand pulls it off to the right; then the left hand steadies and separates the remaining pieces, lifting the yellow block and setting it down so the blocks end up disassembled and spread apart on the bed.
